statements.status_notes: pyo3 is compiled into the Rust extensions of bcrypt 5.0.0, jellyfish 1.2.1, ddtrace 4.15.7 and pydantic-core 2.46.5. The flaw is a missing Sync bound on the closures that PyCFunction::new_closure accepts. None of these extensions calls PyCFunction::new_closure.

pyo3 0.28.3 is compiled into the Rust extensions of ddtrace 4.15.7 and pydantic-core 2.46.5. The flaw is an unchecked index in the PyList and PyTuple iterator nth and nth_back methods, which wraps only when the iterator's position plus n overflows usize. ddtrace calls nth only on Rust string splits. pydantic-core reaches PyTuple nth only through args.iter().enumerate().skip(count) on a fresh iterator, so the position is 0 and n is the schema's positional parameter count, which the code checks against the tuple length first. No extension calls nth_back.

pyo3 0.26.0 is compiled into the Rust extensions of bcrypt 5.0.0 and jellyfish 1.2.1. The flaw is an unchecked index in the PyList and PyTuple iterator nth and nth_back methods. Neither extension calls nth, nth_back, skip or step_by on a PyList or PyTuple iterator; jellyfish's only skip is on a Rust Vec<char>.
